en.title: A Notion page became a course in 5 minutes of generation
en.description: One Notion page of onboarding notes, a real model, the real Studio: 6 lessons and 18 questions for $0.20, and the one workaround I needed.

video.caption: In the clip: the interview and the generation in the Studio of a local academy. Sped up 40 times. The real generation took 4 min 58 s.

pl.title: Strona Notion stała się kursem w 5 minut generowania

video.caption: W filmie: wywiad i generowanie w Studio lokalnej akademii. Przyspieszone 40 razy. Prawdziwe generowanie trwało 4 min 58 s.
